subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the closest approximate value which will come in place of question mark(?) in the following equation?

18.96 + 12.96 + 15.16 - 17.89 × 2.04 + 49.93 ÷ 5.1 = ?
solution:
Given:

18.96 + 12.96 + 15.16 - 17.89 × 2.04 + 49.93 ÷ 5.1 = ?

Formula Used:

Perform arithmetic operations following BODMAS/BIDMAS rules.

Calculation:

Use approximation from first step,

18.96 + 12.96 + 15.16 - 17.89 × 2.04 + 49.93 ÷ 5.1 = ?

Becomes,

19 + 13 + 15 - 18 × 2 + 50 ÷ 5

⇒ 19 + 13 + 15 - 36 + 10

⇒ 21

The correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__

 

Given:

18.96 + 12.96 + 15.16 - 17.89 × 2.04 + 49.93 ÷ 5.1 = ?

Formula Used:

Perform arithmetic operations following BODMAS/BIDMAS rules.

Calculation:

First, handle the multiplication and division:

17.89 × 2.04 = 36.5256

49.93 ÷ 5.1 = 9.7843

Now substitute these values back into the equation:

⇒ 18.96 + 12.96 + 15.16 - 36.5256 + 9.7843

Combine the addition and subtraction:

⇒ 18.96 + 12.96 + 15.16 = 47.08

⇒ 47.08 - 36.5256 = 10.5544

⇒ 10.5544 + 9.7843 = 20.3387

The closest approximate value is 21.

The correct answer is option 4.
